D/ DNCONSTAN TIVS PF AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP RE PARATIO

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), fallen horseman issue of 355-361, possibly Constantinople mint. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DNCONSTAN TIVS PF AVG.
